sloka: गवाम् शत सहस्रेण दीयताम् शबला मम ।रत्नम् हि भगवन् एतत् रत्न हारी च पार्थिवः ॥१-५३-९॥
transliteration: gavām śata sahasreṇa dīyatām śabalā mama ।ratnam hi bhagavan etat ratna hārī ca pārthivaḥ ॥1-53-9॥

translations.english: "I shall give you a hundred thousand cows in exchange for Sabala. O Respectable one this cow is a gem. A king (along) has a right on jewels, O Brahmin, for that reason, Sabala rightfully belongs to me. Therefore, give this cow".
